caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a human figure standing atop a pedestal. The statue appears to be made of painted wood or stone with visible sculptural details, and it is shown wearing a garment consisting of a blue and yellow tunic with leaf-like patterns and brownish pants. The figure has a necklace with round beads, a draped scarf or sash over its shoulder, and a head covering or turban that is brown. The skin of the figure is a muted brown tone. One arm is raised upward with an open hand, while the other arm is bent forward, extending outward with the hand palm-down. The facial features are prominently carved and painted, with large eyes, eyebrows, a prominent nose, and an open mouth. The statue stands on a round base set atop a green, square-topped pedestal. The background is plain and uncolored, consisting of a light beige or off-white tone, and the drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular line. The artist's name, "MINA LOWRY," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
